summary: Rubico Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Common Share Purchase Agreement with B. Riley Principal Capital II, allowing the sale of up to $50 million of common shares at the company's option over 36 months. The purchase price is 97% of VWAP, with a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap. Sales are subject to Nasdaq price minimums and volume limits. This is an at-the-market equity facility, not a special-situation event. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for dilutive impact if shares are sold.
